Why? I'm just left pondering that question, as I scroll through your dedicated subverse. Why do you have an entire subverse for a channel with 400 subscribers? Why do you post so many videos that just seem like the same old stuff I've seen from countless other YouTubers?

I know, "Well, why not?" But we both know that's a complete cop-out that doesn't answer anything. I'm genuinely interested in this project of yours, but I can't wrap my head around the motivation for it. This isn't meant to be abrasive, I am coming completely from a place of curiosity, I swear.

I understand the curiosity, I mean, it seems strange that a channel with only 400 subs would have it's own facebook, twitter, voat, reddit, website, etc, but to explain, i'll have to delve back into the history of The Insane Gamers.

Back in 2010, we were a small clan on Halo Reach, and to be honest, we were average. But around that time on Youtube, popular COD and Halo commentary channels were saying, if you're in a clan, get a HD PVR, because it'll make you better. (If you didn't know, a HD PVR is a recording device that will allow you to record Xbox, Playstation and Wii.) The reasoning behind this was that you could watch your footage back later and see where you went wrong. Eventually people left the clan as Halo 4 came out, and people jumped ship to COD.

Now, those who were left in the clan (which was 4 of us me (Rob), Chris, Wymer and Aaron), had no reason to record halo gameplay, but Multiplayer let's plays such as GTA were becoming a thing, so we started doing that. Of course, it's hard to get noticed if everyone is playing GTA, and then Xbox One & PS4 come out. Me & Aaron? Xbox One. Wymer? PS4. Chris? He switches to PC.

Now occasionally, one of those multiplayer videos will come out, just see some of the Euro Truck Simulator 2 Multiplayer videos, but now, it's mainly me on my own. But why do I still make videos? If you visit the subreddit for let's plays, there are five common tips.

  1. Keep a good schedule. Viewers want to know when to find your new content.

  2. Create Niche content, if possible. That's what this series was (Rob vs. the PS2), although it's currently on hiatus.

  3. Personality is everything. Anyone can talk over a game, but people subscribe to hear your commentary.

  4. Promote your content. If nobody can find your content, how can people find your personality? Even if nobody clicked on the link or visited this subverse, Google realises the link is a youtube link, and the more websites that link to a youtube video, the more it will be promoted on youtube.

  5. Create gateway videos. Gateway videos are videos that are unlike your regular content. (such as this).

There are people on the let's play subreddit that continue posting content every day, and they've been going since 2007 and they only have 700 subs.

But there is another motivation, and that is experience. Currently, I am at college in the UK studying Media, ICT and Business. Why does this matter? Obviously Youtube is media, so any of the gateway videos produced and views thereof can be placed on a CV. All the equipment needs to be hooked up, and many things can go wrong, so this helps in ICT. And technically, this is a business, so things learned in that lesson can be applied here. But I'm also using it for learning editing skills. I mean, this is a Machinima that I'm working on.

I hope this explains the reason behind all this, I'm not doing it to become noticed in the youtube world (although that'd be a nice bonus), i'm doing it because I enjoy creating content, whether one person, or 1 people watch it. - Rob.

Phyra has been pondering the structure in this world, he had been worried from the day Xom spread his miserable dust of chaos. The first seeds of chaos never bode well. But Phyra thought of himself as progressive, surely he was flexible, more so than Shamar, god of stasis.

Earlier in the day he had walked to the nicely organised home of Roxxarum, god of strength, metalwork and masonry. Ja'Maken, the forge, it was a massive structure, but the structure was symmetrical and inside hard work was being done. Roxxarum valued strength a lot, and therefore he valued discipline. Phyra hoped to find some common ground. Roxxarum took Phyra up to the top of the Forge, the heat was blazing and too much for Phyra too handle. Laughingly Roxxarum accepted the request go to the cool study somewhere on the ground floors. At the table Phyra explained his worries in a boring monologue.

----------

"It hasn't been a day since out of Chaos and Luck life erupted. Life grows in unexpected forms and with no real purpose. So I try to instill order in the world by creating systems, checks and balances. Yet life grows too fast and the meddling of the other gods is tiresome to correct. I fear that there will come a point in time where order of the world will be lost. I need a safeguard."

Roxxarum looks back tiredly, the monologue from Phyra had been going on for a while. Meanwhile, he was getting cold and already started missing his forge. "What about some hard wrought weapons? You can ask Yuna to create you some peacekeepers. I can arm them with the best blades of the universe, you can create an army to instill the order you seek. Dreka and Mars would approve."

"That's very kind Roxxarum. At the moment however the world is in order, the races I've seen so far are bound to social structures, the land we walk on is being shaped as Anar & Rana had wished it to be, space follows laws and time is a constant."

Roxxarum felt insulted that his nice gesture was done off with so quickly. As Phyra was the first to come to him, he had thought he would be able to provide an army with gear of the gods for prosperity of Gaea. Why did Phyra come to the forge if he didn't want arms?

"You see Roxxarum, I need something more destructive than a single blade could hope to be. I aim to harness the power you adore. I aim to harness fire."

This peeked Roxxarum, Phyra could see the glimmer. He decided time was there to propose the plan.

"I would like to build a golem unlike any ever seen. During times of order this golem will be a sleeping volcano. In times of unavoidable chaos it will be the purge of the Gaea, it will walk around scalding everything in it's path. Providing us with fertile ground to start anew. Offcourse Ja'Makan is able to resist the lava, my golem won't destroy your forge. [Here are the plans](https://s-media-cache-ak0.pinimg.com/736x/48/41/4c/48414c28c046f92c07ae18717904ed84.jpg) Think it over, the creation of this golem is not yet a pressing concern."

Roxxarum took hold of the sketches waringly, this was a very destructive request, he had to ponder on his answer to help in its creation.

"In the meanwhile," Phyra continued "I will go consult with Omegaiagaky to see about what size we can make it."
